title: Binary Search
hook: Find a hidden number without checking every option.
learningObjectives: Explain why binary search needs sorted data
Describe how each comparison removes half the search space

segments.title: The guessing shortcut
segments.narration: Imagine finding a word by opening a dictionary near the middle instead of starting at page one.

segments.title: Start with sorted data
segments.narration: Binary search works because every value before the middle is smaller and every value after it is larger.

segments.title: Compare once
segments.narration: If the target is larger than the middle value, discard the entire lower half.

segments.title: Repeat on the smaller range
segments.narration: Check the new middle and halve the remaining range again until the target is found.

segments.title: Half, then half again
segments.narration: Binary search is fast because one comparison removes half of the remaining possibilities.

quizzes.question: What must be true before binary search begins?
options: The target is in the middle
quizzes.explanation: Sorting makes it safe to discard one whole half after a comparison.
